about: Plans of the mix engine with files made of signals (Signal in packages/audio/src/engine/test-support.ts), and the SHA-256 of their mix from the start, left then right, as 32-bit floats, little-endian. The same implementation on the same platform gives the same hash. Another one (another browser, Node on another machine) need not: sums that nearly cancel can differ in their last place (Chromium and Node differ by about -355 dBFS in 16 samples of the last case). So where the hash differs, every 241st sample of each channel (`samples`) has to come within -90 dBFS. A changed sound is on purpose only, with a new name for what changed (audio-mixing.md 2.4 of AnimaQuill Cloud).
